title: LeetCode patterns, algorithms and data structures
subtitle: Solve classic coding interview problems with optimal time/space complexity in Python.
goal: Implement and defend optimal algorithmic patterns in Python
intro: Master essential coding interview problem patterns—two pointers, sliding window, hash-map indexing, binary search, tree and graph traversal, heap management, and dynamic programming—with rigorous Big-O complexity analysis and failure boundaries.
terms: The asymptotic upper bound (Big-O) on the number of elementary operations an algorithm executes as input size grows.
The asymptotic auxiliary memory consumed by an algorithm, excluding the input representation itself.
An algorithmic technique maintaining two indices to process sorted arrays or linked lists in a single O(n) pass.
A range-tracking technique expanding and contracting window boundaries to evaluate contiguous subarray or substring constraints.
flow: Choose optimal data structure and pattern
Prove Big-O complexity and test edge cases
case: Implement and defend optimal algorithmic patterns in Python
Demonstrate optimal time and space complexity across core LeetCode algorithmic archetypes with passing observable test assertions.
Test edge cases including empty collections, single elements, negative values, duplicates, and cycle conditions.
